correctness.rationale: For odd finite fields, the collision equation has only unordered-pair collisions when the first-coordinate sum is nonzero and one exceptional zero-sum fiber. This gives the exact weighted identity Q=2S^2-P4-2R+|B|^2. Maximization over antipodal pairs is exact, and the equality conditions force and are forced by constant modulus together with a common phase for all antipodal products. Ambient/surface normalizations agree with the standard finite-field extension convention.

value.rationale: The multiplicative hyperbola is a canonical Kloosterman surface and nondegenerate quadratic curve. The result upgrades a known bounded endpoint estimate to an exact finite-q norm with complete maximizers, and identifies the exceptional zero-sum fiber as the structural source of the finite-size correction and phase rigidity. This is a natural sharp-restriction invariant rather than a routine recomputation.
